name: epistemic-protocols
description: A domain-free metalanguage of structured types and morphisms that moves the cognitive load of human-AI collaboration from recall to recognition: unknowns are elicited into utterance and answered or recognized where they bind, before local misalignment hardens into system-wide rework.

plugins.name: katalepsis
plugins.description: Close on an understanding that serves your purpose, on a map built with you and checked against its material — /grasp (κατάληψις: a grasping firmly)

plugins.name: aitesis
plugins.description: Recognize what the work rests on — what was settled and from where, what rests on weak or unreached ground, what only you decide — /inquire (αἴτησις: a requesting)

plugins.name: analogia
plugins.description: See what a framework, analogy, or earlier design carried to a case supports — each conclusion's grounds, checks, defeaters, and verdict — /ground (ἀναλογία: a proportion)

plugins.name: periagoge
plugins.description: Name what your cases share, say which cases it takes in and leaves out, and recognize it as serving your goal — /induce (περιαγωγή: turning-around)

plugins.name: euporia
plugins.description: Reach an intent you can call yours, aligned enough — each recorded value on your own words, what you left open carried — /elicit (εὐπορία: way through)

plugins.name: merismos
plugins.description: Take as yours a plan cutting one autonomous goal into units, each with its checks, accepted gaps, and held judgments — /apportion (μερισμός: an apportionment)

plugins.name: epharmoge
plugins.description: See on one sheet where a result does not fit your situation, each misfit settled or withdrawn, the fixes carried out and reread — /contextualize (ἐφαρμογή: an application)

plugins.name: horismos
plugins.description: See the decisions a task rests on — what each costs if wrong, what settled it, what stays open and who settles it — /bound (ὁρισμός: a bounding)

plugins.name: epistemic-cooperative
plugins.description: Utility skills layered on top of the core protocols; each utility skill's own SKILL.md carries its contract.

plugins.name: anamnesis
plugins.description: Resolve vague recall into recognized context — one session, or a line of work, topic, or settled concept across several — /recollect (ἀνάμνησις: recollection)

plugins.name: hyphegesis
plugins.description: Take as yours how several lines of work run — order, combination, stopping points, where results go, what you entrusted and kept — /conduct (ὑφήγησις: a leading-the-way)

plugins.name: proplasma
plugins.description: See what taking each candidate direction means for your purpose and on what ground, then settle the one you take — /preview (πρόπλασμα: a preliminary clay model)

plugins.name: hypotyposis
plugins.description: React to concrete versions until you can point at one you met and say: this is the form, for this purpose — /sketch (ὑποτύπωσις: an outline, a first sketch)

plugins.name: heuresis
plugins.description: Widen an empty or prematurely narrowed field of ideas before choosing — /ideate (εὕρεσις: finding/invention)

plugins.name: route
plugins.description: Meet the deficit your context shows as the core protocol that resolves it, and see why, without recalling which exist — /route (per-prompt hook directive)
